# injneer — Gursimran Singh

> Gursimran Singh (injneer) is an Automation Engineer and Web3 developer based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. He builds industrial control systems for paint finishing lines — air makeup units, infrared cure ovens, booths and conveyors — and develops Web3 applications and smart contracts.

## About
- Name: Gursimran Singh, also known as injneer
- Location: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada
- Experience: 5+ years, 100+ control panels built
- Contact: singh@injneer.com

## Services
- Industrial control panels: design, assembly and commissioning of UL-listed panels for paint lines, ovens and air handling systems
- PLC and HMI programming: Allen-Bradley and Siemens, from logic design to SCADA integration and field commissioning
- Infrared oven controls: gas catalytic IR ovens — temperature profiling, zone control, safety interlocks
- Paint line automation: conveyors, booths, ovens and chemical monitoring
- IoT and sensor systems: ESP32/ESP8266 sensor networks, remote telemetry, real-time data acquisition
- Web3 development: smart contracts, dApp architecture, decentralized protocols
